AKE90-8 KV35 ↗

55 N·mRated torque170 N·mPeak torque700 WManufacturer-rated power120 rpmRated speed1.4 kgMechanical-unit mass

AKE90-8 KV35 is the user-reported planned knee actuator; installation is unconfirmed. The default product is a motor + 8:1 gearbox without a controller. Its 55 / 170 N·m values already refer to the geared output. Additional knee linkage, belt ratio and efficiency are unknown.

Based on current official model, KV and feedback entries. Allowed supply ranges and optional driver bundles are not expanded into invented products. Frameless values are motor-side; geared AK/AKE values are gearbox-output values. Hall sensors are not encoders. Power remains absent where the source does not tie it to the recorded supply configuration.
